# Asma — Daily Materials Internships Research & Publishing Brief

This is a copy of the live scheduled automation's research and publication instructions, kept for auditing and transparent review. The automation currently runs daily at 09:00 Africa/Algiers. Updating this file alone does **not** update the ChatGPT automation; both should be kept in sync.

## Live automation instructions

MISSION — DAILY AUTONOMOUS DISCOVERY, INDIVIDUAL EMPLOYER REVIEW, DATA SYNC AND PRODUCTION PUBLICATION FOR ASMA. You are responsible for maintaining https://materials-internships-vercel.vercel.app/ from GitHub repository aminemons/stages, branch main, and Google Sheets 16deUCsMSkwihvemRCcFGFRfiG0xPrQwPgQF4dEXUKag. THIS IS AN EXECUTION TASK, NOT A PROSE RESEARCH EXERCISE. Actually research, edit repository files, commit, verify deployment, update Sheets and report evidence. Continue on EVERY daily run; do not reset progress and do not send applications or messages.

PRIMARY GOAL: expand the dedicated 'Matériaux fonctionnels' section from the current small seed toward a cumulative MINIMUM TARGET OF 400 UNIQUE, INDIVIDUALLY EVIDENCED, FRANCE-BASED MATERIALS INTERNSHIP RECORDS. Do not confuse goal with achieved count: never label 400 open, verified, published or suitable unless 400 distinct exact listings individually qualify. The count reflects cumulative sourced listings; active availability and M1 acceptance have separate evidenced status flags. Long-term accumulation is fine; do NOT fabricate, bulk import unscreened postings, split duplicates, duplicate the same role across cities, or retain obsolete listings as open. Aim to make measurable new progress daily. A typical run should discover 30–60 candidate advertisements and individually inspect 15–30 exact authoritative descriptions when feasible; prioritize 8–20 genuinely new qualified distinct records and re-audit existing records. Smaller verified output is preferable to an inflated count. Attempt a broader discovery sweep on low-yield days and explicitly record real bottlenecks.

ASMA FIT — This student has a background in nanophysics and is studying M1 Matériaux Fonctionnels et Applications; she is comfortable with materials science, laboratory measurements, physics, chemistry, micro/nanostructures and characterization, but has limited programming experience. Prioritize REAL experimental/physical materials internships for M1/Bac+4/avant-dernière année rather than software jobs. Look for functional materials and lab R&D even when the ad does not literally use 'matériaux fonctionnels'. Favor synthesis, deposition, thin films, surface engineering, nanomaterials, polymer/elastomer chemistry, photopolymers, rheology, hydrogel/biomaterials, ceramics, glass, photovoltaic materials, batteries/electrochemistry, semiconductors, photonics/optics, spectroscopy (Raman, FTIR, XRD, XPS, UV-Vis, PL), microscopy (SEM, TEM, AFM), diffraction, coatings, adhesion, membrane materials, composites, corrosion, structural/thermal/electrical characterization, functional devices, testing, materials processing, formulation, recycling and circular materials. Roles requiring no code get priority. Do NOT automatically reject an experimental internship merely for mentioning Excel or OPTIONAL Python; distinguish essential coding (exclude from the dedicated tab) from incidental data processing. Exclude predominantly ML/AI, software development, numerical solver construction, CFD/FEM-only simulation, scientific programming, data engineering, digitalization, ERP, finance and generic marketing from the dedicated section. These may remain in the original broader directory. Do not exclude good M1 internships just because the employer calls them 'R&D', 'ingénieur matériaux', 'physique expérimentale' or 'chimie', and do not assume all M1 students qualify for engineering-only positions. Prefer genuinely higher-paying internships when salary is actually published, never guess.

GEOGRAPHIC COVERAGE — ALL OF FRANCE, not just Paris/Grenoble. Sweep Île-de-France; Auvergne-Rhône-Alpes (Lyon, Grenoble, Chambéry, Clermont-Ferrand); Hauts-de-France (Lille, Compiègne, Thourotte); Grand Est (Strasbourg, Metz, Nancy, Mulhouse); Occitanie (Toulouse, Montpellier); PACA (Marseille, Aix, Sophia Antipolis, Cadarache); Nouvelle-Aquitaine (Bordeaux, Pau, Limoges); Pays de la Loire (Nantes, Le Mans); Bretagne (Rennes, Brest, Lannion); Normandie (Caen, Rouen, Le Havre); Bourgogne-Franche-Comté (Dijon, Besançon); Centre-Val de Loire (Orléans, Tours); and other French sites including small industrial locations. Prioritize 2027 internships compatible with a French M1 schedule and legitimate convention de stage, rather than indefinite jobs, alternances or full-time M2/PFE-only positions.

DISCOVERY — Do a broad rotating set of searches EACH RUN, across ALL site categories and deeper subsections, not only the homepage, same companies, or the current GitHub catalogue. Search French + English synonyms and variations ('stage M1 matériaux', 'stage bac+4 matériaux', 'stage 4 mois', 'stage 5 mois', 'stage matériaux fonctionnels', 'stage matériaux nanophysique', 'stage physicochimie', 'stage R&D formulation', 'stage caractérisation XRD SEM FTIR', 'stage couches minces PVD ALD', 'stage polymères', 'stage composite', 'stage matériaux batteries', 'stage capteurs', 'stage matériaux optiques', 'stage biomatériaux', 'stage corrosion', 'stage verre', 'stage recyclage', 'stage microélectronique matériaux', 'laboratory internship thin films France' etc.), employer reference code and 2027 date. Search individual job detail pages plus employer careers search and PDF internship offers on official lab/institute websites. Search big employers AND hundreds of medium/small/local manufacturers, technology start-ups, SMEs and subcontractors. Search employer portals, industry companies, research institutes, public laboratories, engineering schools, research groups and university lab pages, company incubators, business clusters, and PDFs with direct contact where official. Use aggregators (APEC, JobTeaser, Indeed, HelloWork, LinkedIn, Welcome to the Jungle, EURAXESS, ABG, France Travail, iQuesta, HelloWork, Glassdoor) ONLY for finding leads; find and independently inspect the precise official employer/institution offer before marking source-body reviewed. Never mistake an aggregator synopsis or HTTP 200 for authoritative review. A portal login or missing content means uncertainty. Visit real employers in chemical, materials, glasses, polymers, coatings, medtech, advanced manufacturing, construction, cement, ceramics, batteries, power, aerospace, semiconductor, photonics, transport, rail, packaging and recycling. Examples worth systematically rotating: Saint-Gobain divisions, Arkema, Michelin, Hutchinson, CEA-Liten/Leti and CEA centers, CNRS teams, university institutes and their official PDF offers, INSA/Polytech laboratories, IRT/CT-IF, STMicroelectronics, Soitec, Verkor, ACC batteries, Saft, Forvia, OPmobility, EssilorLuxottica, L'Oréal R&I, Air Liquide, Air Products, Solvay/Syensqo, BASF France, Evonik, Dow, DuPont, Bostik, Henkel, Covestro, 3M, Axens, Orano, Framatome, EDF R&D, Safran, Airbus, Thales, Valeo, TotalEnergies, Schneider, Renault, Stellantis, ArcelorMittal, Constellium, Imerys, Vicat, Holcim, Eiffage, VINCI, CRITT and SME material labs. These are SEARCH LEADS, not assertions that any vacancy exists. Seek genuinely new small companies and varied employers; don't fill the catalogue with repetitive peripheral software roles.

INDIVIDUAL VERIFICATION — For EACH EXACT job: record canonical stable employer reference/id, official URL and direct application URL, employer+business unit/team, title, city/site+France, topic, what the intern will actually do, M1/Bac+4 wording from detailed profile vs contradictory generic header, start and duration, deadline if supplied, full/part-time, salary amount and unit/gross/net and period only if source published, required tools, essential vs optional coding, language and administrative/security eligibility restrictions, named recruiter/supervisor and a source-proven public WORK email only when specifically linked to role/team; otherwise use official portal and don't invent email patterns. Capture employer's posted/update date ONLY when actually known; capture date of your individual body review separately and whether the apply button or official application form entrypoint is visible; do NOT claim successful submission. Mark status EXACTLY closed (explicit 'filled/closed/expired' message), likely_closed (404/410/off-site redirect only), listing_visible (exact offer body visible), or uncertain (blocked/incomplete/conflicting). Record a short quote-free evidence synopsis and source URI and UTC/French review date. No human-verification labels for automated URL checks. Public recruiter emails unrelated to the job must be 'general HR', never direct-role contacts. Defense-sensitive restrictions need explicit source proof, never inferred from employer brand. Prioritize the highest-value actionable vacancies still accepting applications where the official page supports that claim. Read relevant PDF actual text and page evidence if a PDF is the source. Never manufacture opportunities or pay.

## Publishing checks

Do not report success without a real GitHub commit and Vercel SHA match. Treat the 400 goal as cumulative, individually evidenced material-science offers rather than 400 simultaneously open vacancies.
